enMap.「はずがない／はずはない」là hình thức phủ định của「は: 「はずがない／はずはない」is the negative form of「はずだ」, and means "unreasonable", "impossible". It is used to strongly deny something, based on solid grounds.
enMap.Ngoài ra, khi phủ nhận mạnh mẽ những gì: Besides, when strongly denying what someone has said, with the sense that it is not true, the pattern「そんなはずはない」is used.
enMap.[...はずだった」là hình thức quá khứ của [...は: [...はずだった」is the past form of [...はずだ」, indicating that the speaker had thought something would naturally turn out that way. It is often used when the result differs from what had been predicted.
(2) In most cases [...ことがある」and「こともある」are used with the same meaning.

zhMap.「はずがない／はずはない」là hình thức phủ định của「は: 「はずがない／はずはない」是「はずだ」的否定形式，意思是“不合理”、“不可能”。用于根据确凿依据强烈否定那件事。
